description: I hear this question a lot.After traveling Tennessee throughout the campaign, my answer has changed: A WORKING tour of all 95 counties. I’ve seen with my own eyes how divided we’ve become — and how obvious it is which communities get attention and which get passed over due to politics.Too many public servants seem to stop showing up where they think they can’t win votes. The people living there still have needs. Still pay taxes. Still deserve representation. They are not enemies!Your ZIP code an
